premise: Pinecone lets go of her branch and rolls down the hill, bump bump bump; Squirrel and Hedgehog chase her; at the bottom she has found the sunniest spot in the forest.
inspiration: The Runaway Pancake (folk chase tale), turned: nobody catches or eats the runaway; the roll is a joyride, and it ends in the best spot of all.
lesson: Sometimes rolling away is going somewhere.

en-US.title: Pinecone Rolls Away
en-US.text: {pinecone:pulse} Pinecone lived at the very top of the tall tree. {tree:pulse} One windy morning — {tree:wobble x2} whoops! — she let go. Down she came. {pinecone:spin x3} {sfx:bump} Bump! Bump! Bump! Off the branch and away! [rushed] Squirrel {squirrel:hop x3} saw her go. Stop! Hedgehog {hedgehog:wobble} woke up. What is rolling? A pinecone! Catch her! And they ran. Pinecone rolled past Mouse. {mouse:hop} She rolled through the puddle, splash, and through the leaves, crunch, and over a stone, {pinecone:hop} boing! [excited] I am rolling too, said Hedgehog, and he was, in a ball, {hedgehog:spin x2} round and round. Then the hill ran out. {sfx:land solo} Pinecone stopped. Squirrel stopped. Hedgehog un-rolled. [surprised] They were at the bottom of the hill, in the brightest, sunniest spot in the whole forest. {pinecone:glow} [happily] I was not running away, said Pinecone. I was going somewhere. And they all lay down in the sun.

es-ES.title: Piña rueda cuesta abajo
es-ES.text: {pinecone:pulse} Piña vivía en lo más alto del árbol alto. {tree:pulse} Una mañana de viento — {tree:wobble x2} ¡ups! — se soltó. Y para abajo. {pinecone:spin x3} {sfx:bump} ¡Pum! ¡Pum! ¡Pum! Rama abajo, ¡y lejos! [rushed] Ardilla {squirrel:hop x3} la vio pasar. ¡Para! Erizo {hedgehog:wobble} se despertó. ¿Qué es eso que rueda? ¡Una piña! ¡A por ella! Y corrieron. Piña pasó rodando junto a Ratón. {mouse:hop} Cruzó el charco, chof, y las hojas, cranch, y saltó una piedra, {pinecone:hop} ¡boing! [excited] ¡Yo también ruedo!, dijo Erizo, hecho una bola, {hedgehog:spin x2} vuelta y vuelta. Y entonces se acabó la cuesta. {sfx:land solo} Piña se paró. Ardilla se paró. Erizo se desenrolló. [surprised] Estaban al pie de la colina, en el rincón más soleado y luminoso de todo el bosque. {pinecone:glow} [happily] No me escapaba, dijo Piña. Es que iba a un sitio. Y se tumbaron los tres al sol.

bump.prompt: a pinecone bouncing down through branches and onto soft ground, three light woody bumps

land.prompt: a pinecone rolling to a stop in soft grass, a gentle rustle and settle
